TERMINAL PREFERENCES

Settings & backups

Your data stays here

Notes save in this browser on this address. The hosted app and local app have separate storage. Clearing browser data removes notes. Export regular backups or move notes between addresses with export and import.

Import merges notes by ID and keeps the newer edited version. It never replaces a newer local note.

Local agent inbox

On Arch Linux, the desktop launcher opens the local app at http://127.0.0.1:4783. Your agents can list and acknowledge handoffs with the included CLI.
